Your profile

Beware of fraudulent job offers: Please check whether the position is published on our official careers page. 
Throughout the recruitment process, we will communicate exclusively through our official JvM channels. 
We will never ask for payments, bank details, or the purchase of work equipment.

Your Profile

Jung von Matt TECH is looking for a Senior Strategist Data & AI (m/f/d)


About you

  • You turn complex and technical topics into presentations that are easy to follow and engaging. You build a clear storyline, a strong visual structure and slides that make one point at a time.
  • You are genuinely curious about the strategic questions AI raises for brands: What does brand management look like when AI agents research, compare and buy on behalf of people? How do brands stay visible in AI-generated answers (GEO)? How must marketing organizations change?
  • You form your own point of view and can explain what AI developments mean for large companies and brands, including their organization, processes and business models.
  • You know the AI landscape well and use AI tools, automations and agents where they sharpen thinking and speed up results.
  • You bring a strong command of strategic frameworks and storytelling.
  • You have high data literacy and experience with complex datasets, market research and analytics.
  • You understand media, creative and business KPIs and processes. 
  • You take ownership, make sound decisions and communicate in a clear, structured way.


The Tasks

  • Develop strategic answers to our clients' AI questions, e.g. GEO, brand management in AI-driven ecosystems and the role of automations in marketing organizations
  • Translate complex analyses and technical topics into compelling presentations and actionable recommendations
  • Collaborate closely with creative, media, consulting and tech teams
  • Facilitate workshops and present to clients
  • Evaluate AI tools, methods and automations and bring the relevant ones into client projects
  • Guide and mentor junior and mid-level team members
  • Ensure strategic quality, efficiency and profitability
  • Support new business pitches and strategic growth initiatives
  • Contribute to our thought leadership on AI and the future of brands
